summary: Oregon Dept. of Forestry three-story frame lookout built 1958 on Spirit Mountain; removed or destroyed 1973; mountain privately owned today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firetower.org says the tower was removed in 1973 and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1973; the district history gives only a 1970s date and says removed. The story reports both wordings and does not pick one.
firetower.org and firelookout.com list the lookout site at 1,772 ft; the Oregon Encyclopedia gives the mountain as rising to 1,759 ft. The story uses the site figure.

notes_for_editor: Build date (1958) is consistent across three sources. Fate is disputed (removed vs destroyed, 1973 vs a 1970s date). No source describes the site today, so the story says so. The 'private' access level rests on the Oregon Encyclopedia's ownership statement, which may be dated; the brief's access 'unknown' is now answered. Staffing is not documented; the district history's 1966 line ('No first reports made from this station') was left out as ambiguous. firetower.org has 1958-1973 photos (Howard Verschoor collection), but no image URLs or licence were captured, so none were added.
